title: gui: Diagrams mode framework + Control-flow tab (CFG renderer)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W3]
Seats: GRAPH-01, GRAPH-02, GRAPH-09
Add Mode::Diagrams (4th mode) and crates/gui/src/diagrams/{mod,common,control}.rs. common.rs: shared canvas kit (pan/zoom/click-to-source, node boxes with theme tokens, edge styles incl. labeled True/False/Back, no per-frame allocations of the graph). control.rs: render one function's FunctionCfg from analysis.json — Entry/Exit/Block/Branch/Loop/Match/Call/Return node shapes, labels carrying real condition text, complexity badge (cyclomatic + max nesting), function picker reusing search/explain selection; honest empty state when analysis is missing or the function has no CFG. Wiring: app.rs (Mode arm + toolbar segment + palette + Tab cycle), main.rs mod decl. Consume theme tokens only. Owner: crates/gui/src/diagrams/*, app.rs, main.rs. Verify: cargo build -p repowalk-gui && cargo clippy -p repowalk-gui --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p repowalk-gui.

EVIDENCE:
File: crates/gui/src/diagrams/control.rs (the only file touched; 4 inline tests). No other file touched.
What the view shows (Diagrams mode -> "Control flow" tab): left rail is a filterable function picker built from analysis.cfgs, labelled with the index-resolved symbol name + cyclomatic, sorted most-complex-first (same key as complexity::hotspots: cyclomatic desc, symbol asc). Clicking a row calls app.select(Selection::Symbol(id)), so one selection drives every pane, and the right canvas renders that FunctionCfg: Entry/Exit as pills (success/danger), Branch/Loop/Match as chamfered lozenges (accent/info/warning), Call/Return/Block as plain boxes; every node carries its kind tag, real label text, and start line. Edges are arrows labelled true/false/back; CfgEdgeKind::Back is routed out the left lane, dashed in warning colour, so it visibly loops back. A badge strip shows cyclomatic + max nesting (+ node/edge counts) above the canvas; the canvas pans via ScrollArea; truncated labels reveal their full text on hover.
Honest states: no analysis -> "press Learn"; file/none selected -> prompt to pick a function; selected symbol has no CFG -> "no control-flow graph for this function"; empty CFG -> says so; >300 nodes -> renders only the entry-reachable subgraph AND prints "capped at 300 nodes ... N node(s) omitted". Layout is pure + deterministic (BFS-depth layered, entry row 0, nodes ordered by id per row).
